title: 2021 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Stéphane Peterhansel / Edouard Boulanger (Bahrain JCW X-Raid) and Kevin Benavides (Monster Energy Honda)
summary: The 2021 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its Saudi Arabia era: 11 stage towns and bivouacs through Saudi Arabia. Winners — Cars: Stéphane Peterhansel / Edouard Boulanger (Bahrain JCW X-Raid); Bikes: Kevin Benavides (Monster Energy Honda); Quads: Manuel Andújar (7240 Team); Light prototypes: Josef Macháček / Pavel Vyoral (Buggyra Zero Mileage Racing); UTVs: Francisco Lopez Contardo / Juan Pablo Latrach Vinagre (South Racing Can-Am).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
